_comment: A getAlbumList2 page that is SHORTER than the requested size=500. Some servers
silently cap page size below what the client asked for, so a short page does NOT
mean the library ended here. Treating it as the last page truncated users'
libraries once already — see the termination-rule comment at
src/subsonic/useSubsonic.ts:185. The parser must simply report the 2 albums it got
and expose nothing that invites the caller to infer 'done'.
MAINTENANCE: this array must stay well under 500 entries. If it ever grew to the
requested page size, the fixture would silently stop exercising the short-page case.
